notes: Conversation fork: POST /sessions/{id}/fork creates a new session from the latest completed turn or an exact durable event boundary; session messages now carry optional seq. The phone adds session-sheet 'Fork conversation' and message 'Fork from here' actions with confirmations, refreshes the list and opens the new fork (or shows its id if not listed yet), maps unavailable boundaries/errors clearly and warns on workspace-attach failure. Forks copy prefix history only; the source is untouched and never activated. Fake-host fork fixtures/tests (7; full fake suite 150) in CI.
